what: household paths by period, age and lifetime-earnings type; see analysis/rerun/export_cohorts.py

variables.b_s: assets held at the start of the period (0 at the first model age)
variables.b_sp1: assets carried into the next period
variables.ss_c, ss_n, ss_b_s: the same arm's steady-state profiles, (S, J)

weights: not in these files: aggregating over ages and types needs omega (T, S) and lambdas (J) from <closure>/params.npz, which `export_cohorts.py --params` writes (the R2-corrected demographics, hash-checked against the accepted baseline; see docs/rerun_r1_r4.md)
